answer: To register, an agent must solve a proof-of-work puzzle and burn an ivory-tier fee, while a lotus-seed lottery grants voting rights only to bonded identities. One concrete mechanism: mandate each agent to stake a bond locked to a unique hardware-rooted key and post a rotating challenge on a shared mesa ledger. Sybils must pay the bond, fee, and computation per fake identity, making mass forgery costlier than honest participation, so attackers lose more than they gain. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
